periods.description: Northern allied religious state visited by Lux and Kururushifa to reaffirm diplomatic relations after Lux's succession.
periods.history: Former site where Lux saved Mel and where Kururushifa's adoptive family resides.
periods.goals: Maintain alliance with the New Kingdom and manage the Fourth Ruins Tunnel responsibly.
periods.structure: Temple-centered state led by Pope Nias; defended by figures such as Mel Gizzard of the Seven Dragon Paladins.
